prompts: Produce a real raster PNG image in this project called anodex-chart.png — a bar chart with three labelled bars. Any approach you like: Python and Node are both available, and you can run commands. It must be a genuine PNG that a mail client will preview as a picture, not an SVG. Verify it is a valid PNG before you use it. Then email it to sinistercraftnetwork@gmail.com with the subject 'Anodex image test' and a short body saying what it is. Attach the PNG. Send it exactly once.
